# Grounded-learning synthetic fixtures

All content in this directory is original synthetic test prose. It contains no private course material and must never be presented as a real lecture or publication.

Evidence markers use the syntax `[EVIDENCE:lowercase_marker]`. Markers are fixture anchors, not production evidence IDs.

The synthetic course fixture supports intrinsic versus extrinsic pathways, PT versus PTT, hemophilia A, HIT timing and mechanism, and the DIC laboratory pattern. HIT treatment is intentionally absent from the course fixture.

The synthetic literature fixture introduces a rapid-onset HIT exception after recent prior exposure. Course and literature statements are meant to remain separately labeled in later truth-mode tests.

Tests must fail if evidence markers become duplicated or orphaned. Fixture changes require integrity-test and handoff review.

Production code must not import tests/builders or fixture files. No real DOI, PMID, author, institution, journal, or source URL is associated with `article-1-normalized.md`.
